description: Create a paused Google Search campaign (responsive search ad, phrase-match keywords) in the customer's own Google Ads account, saved as a draft the customer activates on the Ads page. Search only; needs the ads add-on and a connected account.

dailyBudgetCents.description: Daily budget in minor units of the ad account currency (e.g. 2000 = 20.00)

geoTargets.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code(s), e.g. ["SE"]; the first supported one is used

language.description: Ad language as a Google language code (sv, en, de, …); defaults to the posting language

targetCpaCents.description: Target CPA in cents if using Target CPA bidding

name: google_ads_create_search_campaign
title: Create Google Search / Performance Max Campaign
